title: Khaake Teer Bhi Asghar Haaye Muskuraya Hai
body:
Khake teer bhi asgher haye muskuraya hai
Bezubaan sipahi jo Karbala mein aaya hai, aasmaan zameen kaanpi jab nazar uthaya hai , hans ke phir zamane ko umr bhar rulaya hai, bekasi ke aalam mein shai ka dil badaya hai, khake teer bhi asgher haye muskara hai
Shah-e-deen ke hathaon par chal ke ghutniyaon aaya, bekasi mein ghurbath mein baap ka jigar thama , banke fathaye dauraon imtehaan se lauta, deenay haq bachane mein azam-e-nau dikhaya hai, khake teer bhi asgher haye muskara hai
Tishnagiye asgher se khoon paani paani hai, kamsini ki himmat par kat gayi jawani hai, gham ka ek fasana hai dard ki kahani hai , so ke khud zamane ko ta abad jagaya hai, khake teer bhi asgher haye muskara hai
Thi sadaye gham har soo mere be zubaan asgher, maa ka dil tadapta hai dene loriyaann Asghar, chod kar mera pehlo so gaye kahan asgher, Karbala ke zarraon ne bas yahi sunaya hai, khake teer bhi asgher haye muskara hai
Sangh dil jigar kaan pe ran mein teer khane par , anbiya ko hairath hai tere muskurane par, khagayi nazar tujhko khaaq hai zamane par, Karbala ka yeh toofaan aansuaon mein aaya hai, khake teer bhi asgher haye muskara hai..
